title: For judges: one page
sentence: The neutral meter for AI agent work: neither side keeps the count.
pitch: Knos lets buyers and suppliers agree what AI work earned payment, and independently prove that agreement later.
number: Of 241 merged agent pull requests claiming passing tests, 9 failed a test, build, lint or type check.
claim: two parties who distrust each other compute the same bill from evidence a third party signed, and the program releases the money on that signature.
why_solana: Money is released with no custodian, and the count is anchored where neither side can alter it.

rows.sentence: A Solana program checked GitHub's signature itself and released the payment, on the public program ids, in test USDC.
rows.label: the paying transaction

rows.sentence: A buyer paying per merge on our sample would have paid for 19 pull requests whose checks failed, read again by hand.
rows.label: the measurement

rows.sentence: The black-box check refused all 63 cheating submissions, and plain CI passed 56 of them.
rows.label: the tamper benchmark

rows.sentence: A buyer pastes an invoice on the first screen and gets the count, with no install and no sign-up.
rows.label: the site

rows.sentence: The code is MIT, and the verifier is a separate program that other Solana programs call.
rows.label: how to call it

rows.sentence: Knos earns one fee, on value released against a signed acceptance, and the supplier never pays.
rows.label: the price book and its costs

rows.sentence: The founder placed first of 92 teams at Sibyl Labs in Sep 2026, and has never sold to an invoice approver.
rows.label: the team, for and against

rows.sentence: Every vendor counts its own outcomes, while the forge already signs a record that neither buyer nor supplier owns.
rows.label: why a neutral count

rows.sentence: Sibyl's memory engine, which the founder's first-place Sibyl Labs product ran on, holds Knos's history; each capability has evidence.
rows.label: the release manifest

rows.sentence: Not counted: the market is built from qualified organisations, and none has been asked yet.
rows.label: the addressable market

rows.sentence: The presentation fits in three minutes: the finding, one transaction, the founder's record, the limits in one sentence, the ask.
rows.label: the presentation

rows.sentence: Each customer's delivery cost is budgeted line by line, only the monthly batch is measured, and nothing has been sold.
rows.label: the unit costs

rows.sentence: Outside funders 0, outside repositories 0, interviews 0, revenue 0; one outside payee was paid on tasks Knos funded.
rows.label: the outside-use numbers

wait: From merge to paid took 26 seconds at the median, over 51 payments on devnet. Days to approve is defined as the days from the day the buyer receives a supplier's invoice to the day a person with authority approves it. Not measured. It has not measured it with any buyer, so no figure for it is given here.
not_real: Money: Solana devnet and test USDC only. Mainnet is not touched.
Buyers: 0 interviews, 0 letters of intent, 0 paying customers, 0 revenue.
Outside use: 0 outside funders and 0 outside repositories. One outside payee was paid 3 times, on tasks Knos funded.
Outside checks: no security review, 0 reproductions by anyone else, 0 outside programs reading the verifier.
Neutrality: one person holds every key, and that person is the whole team.
